description.zh: 触发一个操作，支持变体、语义色调、尺寸与加载态。
description.en: Triggers an action; supports variants, semantic tones, sizes and a loading state.

description.zh: 分组承载相关内容的纯布局容器，自带边框 / 阴影 / 填充三种外观。
description.en: A layout-only container for grouping related content, with border, shadow and filled looks.

description.zh: 对内容进行分类或标记，支持语义色调、多种变体与可关闭交互。
description.en: Labels and categorises content, with semantic tones, variants and dismissible interaction.

description.zh: 接收用户的单行文本输入。
description.en: Accepts a single line of text input.

description.zh: 切换单个选项的开启 / 关闭状态。
description.en: Toggles a single option on or off.

description.zh: 录入多个自由文本标签，支持回车 / 分隔符提交、粘贴拆分与数量 / 去重约束。
description.en: Enters multiple free-text tags with Enter or delimiter commit, paste splitting and count / duplicate limits.

description.zh: 由触发按钮与日历面板组合，选中后按 dateFormat 展示日期。
description.en: Pairs a trigger button with a calendar panel and renders the picked date with dateFormat.

description.zh: 从一组选项中选择单个值。
description.en: Selects a single value from a list of options.

description.zh: 在当前页面之上承载需要用户聚焦处理的内容。
description.en: Presents content that needs focused attention above the current page.

description.zh: 在当前页面内展示一条与上下文相关的反馈信息。
description.en: Shows a contextual feedback message inline on the page.

description.zh: 展示结构化数据，基于无头表格能力自建渲染，默认提供极简表样式与空态。
description.en: Renders structured data on a headless table engine with minimal default styling and an empty state.

description.zh: 展示确定的进度值或不确定的等待状态。
description.en: Shows determinate progress or an indeterminate waiting state.

description.zh: 在一组同级内容间切换，同一时刻只展示一个面板。
description.en: Switches between sibling panels, showing one at a time.
